name: Combat Initiation
desc:
[Beta v2.2.4] 

Gather a team, choose your weapons, select your tools, and ascend the spire of certain death. Do you have what it takes? 

Combat Initiation is a fast-paced arena brickbattle game that puts you in a max group of 6 against all varying threats standing in your way. With all your 7 granted branching weapons to choose from, blaze through every army as you seek to reach the top. 

Inspired by many games, most notably a hit game named ULTRAKILL.
